# Pry MCP — Web Scraping, Browser Automation & Data Intelligence

> Pry is a self-hosted MCP server for web scraping, browser automation, and ten data domains: scrape, crawl, extract, template, monitor, comply, enrich, parse documents, screenshot, plus crypto, marketplace, legal, real estate, jobs, travel, attention, local, gov, and IP intelligence — all monetized via x402 pay-per-call. It bypasses Cloudflare and other anti-bot systems via a 9-tier fallback chain and needs no API keys. Install with `uvx pryscraper-mcp` or `pipx install pryscraper`.

Pry exposes 35 MCP tools. All are self-hosted — the server is a FastAPI app mounted at `/mcp` (Streamable HTTP + HTTP+SSE) plus a stdio entry point (`pry-mcp`). Deploy once, then any MCP client (Claude, Cursor, Hermes, any MCP-compatible agent) can call the tools.

## Tools

### Web scraping & browser automation

- [pry_scrape](https://codeberg.org/cryptorugmunch/pryscraper): Scrape any URL to clean markdown with Cloudflare bypass
- [pry_crawl](https://codeberg.org/cryptorugmunch/pryscraper): Crawl a website from a seed URL up to max_pages
- [pry_extract](https://codeberg.org/cryptorugmunch/pryscraper): Extract structured JSON from a URL via CSS selectors
- [pry_template](https://codeberg.org/cryptorugmunch/pryscraper): Execute one of 110+ pre-built scraper templates
- [pry_search_templates](https://codeberg.org/cryptorugmunch/pryscraper): Search the template catalog by keyword or site
- [pry_monitor](https://codeberg.org/cryptorugmunch/pryscraper): Watch a page for changes; webhook/Slack/Discord alerts
- [pry_compliance](https://codeberg.org/cryptorugmunch/pryscraper): Score scraping legal risk (robots.txt, ToS, GDPR/CCPA)
- [pry_enrich](https://codeberg.org/cryptorugmunch/pryscraper): Enrich a URL with company, tech-stack, social intel
- [pry_parse_document](https://codeberg.org/cryptorugmunch/pryscraper): Parse PDF/DOCX/image into text and tables
- [pry_screenshot](https://codeberg.org/cryptorugmunch/pryscraper): Full-page screenshot as base64 PNG

### Payments & referrals

- [pry_x402_pricing](https://codeberg.org/cryptorugmunch/pryscraper): x402 pay-per-call pricing in USDC atomic units
- [pry_referrals](https://codeberg.org/cryptorugmunch/pryscraper): Referral catalog — 60+ providers with affiliate IDs

### Crypto (crypto_market)

- [pry_token_launches](https://codeberg.org/cryptorugmunch/pryscraper): Token launch and deployer activity intelligence
- [pry_cex_listings](https://codeberg.org/cryptorugmunch/pryscraper): CEX listing/delisting announcements
- [pry_token_security](https://codeberg.org/cryptorugmunch/pryscraper): Token security checks — honeypot, mint, LP lock

### Marketplace

- [pry_amazon_product](https://codeberg.org/cryptorugmunch/pryscraper): Amazon product lookup by ASIN — price, stock, rating
- [pry_amazon_search](https://codeberg.org/cryptorugmunch/pryscraper): Amazon keyword search — listings with price and ASIN
- [pry_walmart_product](https://codeberg.org/cryptorugmunch/pryscraper): Walmart product lookup by ID — price, seller, rating
- [pry_tiktok_trending](https://codeberg.org/cryptorugmunch/pryscraper): Trending TikTok Shop products by engagement

### Legal (legal_docs)

- [pry_legal_dockets](https://codeberg.org/cryptorugmunch/pryscraper): Search U.S. court dockets via CourtListener
- [pry_legal_sec](https://codeberg.org/cryptorugmunch/pryscraper): Search SEC EDGAR filings by ticker and form type
- [pry_legal_sanctions](https://codeberg.org/cryptorugmunch/pryscraper): Screen a name against the OFAC SDN sanctions list

### Real estate

- [pry_realestate_search](https://codeberg.org/cryptorugmunch/pryscraper): Search real-estate listings by location and status

### Jobs

- [pry_jobs_list](https://codeberg.org/cryptorugmunch/pryscraper): List ATS job postings (Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby/Workday)
- [pry_jobs_salary](https://codeberg.org/cryptorugmunch/pryscraper): Salary bands for a company/role from Levels.fyi

### Travel

- [pry_flights_grid](https://codeberg.org/cryptorugmunch/pryscraper): Cheapest flight per day over a date range
- [pry_hotel_rates](https://codeberg.org/cryptorugmunch/pryscraper): Per-night hotel rates for a stay window

### Attention & SEO

- [pry_serp](https://codeberg.org/cryptorugmunch/pryscraper): Google SERP scrape — organic, AI Overview, PAA
- [pry_trends](https://codeberg.org/cryptorugmunch/pryscraper): Google Trends interest timeline and related queries

### Local business

- [pry_places_search](https://codeberg.org/cryptorugmunch/pryscraper): Google Maps local business search
- [pry_reviews](https://codeberg.org/cryptorugmunch/pryscraper): Google Maps / Yelp review history for a place

### Government data

- [pry_procurement](https://codeberg.org/cryptorugmunch/pryscraper): U.S. federal procurement opportunities (SAM.gov)
- [pry_recalls](https://codeberg.org/cryptorugmunch/pryscraper): CPSC/FDA product recalls

### IP data

- [pry_patents](https://codeberg.org/cryptorugmunch/pryscraper): U.S. patent search via USPTO/Google Patents
- [pry_trademarks](https://codeberg.org/cryptorugmunch/pryscraper): U.S. trademark search via USPTO

## Capabilities

- [Anti-bot bypass](https://codeberg.org/cryptorugmunch/pryscraper): 9-tier fallback: direct -> cloudscraper -> FlareSolverr -> Playwright -> Googlebot -> Archive.org -> Google Cache -> Tor -> undetected-chromedriver
- [Document parsing](https://codeberg.org/cryptorugmunch/pryscraper): PDF, DOCX, images (OCR), CSV, JSON
- [x402 pay-per-call](https://codeberg.org/cryptorugmunch/pryscraper): USDC micro-payments across 7 CAIP-2 networks (Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, Solana, TRON), multi-facilitator router
- [MCP 2025 standards](https://codeberg.org/cryptorugmunch/pryscraper): Streamable HTTP + HTTP+SSE + stdio transports, output schemas and annotations on every tool
- [Browser automation](https://codeberg.org/cryptorugmunch/pryscraper): Login flows, form filling, sessions
- [Vision AI](https://codeberg.org/cryptorugmunch/pryscraper): Free OpenRouter vision models with auto-fallback
- [Rate limiting](https://codeberg.org/cryptorugmunch/pryscraper): Per-IP token bucket (default 120 RPM)

## Install

- [Quickstart — README](https://codeberg.org/cryptorugmunch/pryscraper): One-command install + Claude Code / Cursor config
- [Install command](https://codeberg.org/cryptorugmunch/pryscraper): `uvx pryscraper-mcp` or `pipx install pryscraper` then `pry-mcp`
- [MCP registry metadata](https://codeberg.org/cryptorugmunch/pryscraper): `server.json` — name `io.rugmunch/pry`, stdio + streamable-http
- [Smithery deploy](https://codeberg.org/cryptorugmunch/pryscraper): `smithery.yaml` for one-click MCP server hosting
